name: GenomeClaw
description: Personal genomics tools for OpenClaw — query findings, variants, evidence, and reports against a host-side derived store. All raw artifacts stay host-side (INV-D002); the plugin only reaches the host service via the configured network policy preset.

hostService.description: Connection settings for the host-side genomeclaw-service.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the genomeclaw-service. Must use the `host.openshell.internal` alias and a port whitelisted by the genomeclaw OpenShell policy preset.

outputClass.description: Default output class for tool returns. 'summary' enforces INV-P002 minimal-sufficient outputs; 'bulk' must be explicitly opted into per-tool and is reserved for future use.

logVerbosity.description: Plugin log level. Default 'info'. Set to 'debug' only for local troubleshooting; debug logs may include scoped variant identifiers.
